items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: He was a Harry Carney fan.

ctx.x: Well, you know, as you add that fifth saxophone, and you have the baritone --
Yeah, see, we finally added another alto and Jack played strictly baritone because he loved baritone, you see. He was a Harry Carney fan.
He was good, though, wasn't he?
